mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(leave_hours), 0) FROM biz_leave_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND staff_id = #{staffId}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(overtime_hours), 0) FROM biz_overtime_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND confirm_status = 1 AND staff_id = #{staffId}

SELECT es.employee_id AS employeeId, es.employee_name AS employeeName, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.del_flag = 0 THEN o.overtime_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalOvertimeHours, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.del_flag = 0 AND o.confirm_status = 0 THEN o.overtime_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingOvertimeHours, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.del_flag = 0 AND o.confirm_status = 1 THEN o.overtime_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmedOvertimeHours, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(l.leave_hours) FROM biz_leave_record l WHERE l.del_flag = 0 AND l.staff_id = es.employee_id ), 0) AS usedLeaveHours FROM biz_employee_salary es LEFT JOIN biz_overtime_record o ON es.employee_id = o.staff_id WHERE es.del_flag = 0
AND es.employee_id = #{employeeId}
AND es.employee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeName}, '%')
GROUP BY es.employee_id, es.employee_name ORDER BY totalOvertimeHours DESC, es.employee_name ASC
